description: A devastating disease of potato and tomato leaves, causing dark brown spots and rapid leaf death. Can destroy crops quickly under wet conditions.
symptoms: Dark brown to black leaf spots
Leaf edges turn pale and die
favorable_conditions: Poor air circulation in dense plantings
spread: Wind and rain dispersal of spores
management: Improve air circulation with proper spacing and pruning
Rotate crops to prevent inoculum buildup
chemical_control: Mancozeb sprays on foliage during wet periods
prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds or tubers
